recovery_policy.generated_actions: Reuse the MR10D7 generated Ability action pipeline. Ability-generated actions spend no PP, do not consume the selected turn, retain normal targeting/redirection/accuracy/type/immunity/Protect/move-script flow, and may not recursively create another Ability-generated action.
recovery_policy.failure_policy: A blocker in one family must not stop independent families. Record the exact missing dependency and continue.

known_donor_recovery.Amplifier: Sound-based moves target all opposing Pokemon and deal 30 percent more damage.
known_donor_recovery.Riptide: Water-type moves deal 30 percent more damage normally and 80 percent more damage at or below one-third max HP.
known_donor_recovery.Hubris: Raise Special Attack by one stage when the user directly KOs an opponent.
known_donor_recovery.Multi-Headed: Extra strikes depend on head count; authoritative ER documentation gives 2-head total 100%+25% and 3-head total 100%+20%+15%, with independent secondary-effect rolls except flinch. Recover the exact species/head mapping from donor data before wiring species-specific behavior.
